notes: Transcribed from MileSplit raw result text (me.milesplit.com). Schools kept as MileSplit prints them. Prelim/final/heat rows as printed; points column not copied; exhibition marks (x) flagged. Abbreviated or mascot school names (LAC, MTB, Dragons ...) expanded to full names. School codes of this meet read from the meet itself (backend/data/milesplit_codes.json): BRG = Brunswick High School; Brb = Brunswick High School. Second read 2026-10-28: rebuilt from the two Hy-Tek pages (results/314423 Event 1 and results/314424 Event 2, each ONE list of boys and girls together, sex = the B / G on the team; Brb = Brunswick boys, BRG = Brunswick girls). Before, the girls of both lists sat in Boys events and Event 1 was stored twice (the 240-row list plus the boys-only copy results/315066, labelled 2.8 Mile; same runners, same times, same places, so the copy is dropped; the girls-only copy results/314596 agrees with the list; two typos in it: Wilson 17:57.00 for 17:56.73, Tanner 19:11.45 for 19:11.95, the list kept). Place = rank within the sex; team_place = the Points column as printed (a combined-list rank: team totals are computed on the combined list, with penalty places 123+/241+ for teams of fewer than 5, so they do not reproduce from the single-sex rows; printed as printed). Distances: Event 1 is 2.4 Mile (Hy-Tek; the 2.8 label of the boys copy does not fit: Isaiah Harris 13:17 = 4:45/mi vs his 16:12 state 5K, the 2013 and 2015 Laliberte varsity were 2.4 Mile with winners 13:21 and 13:19); the Event 2 label 2.3 Mile cannot be right (winner 7:39.65 = 3:20/mi; the runners ran 0.40 of their own 5K medians = about 1.2 miles), so it is named 1.2 Mile. The 5 Monmouth Academy B rows that the page-315066 copy shifted by a column are read correctly from the Hy-Tek list. School codes: HD = Hall-Dale, McI = Maine Central Institute, Skowhegan XC = Skowhegan Area, Lawrence Bulldogs = Lawrence, Mt Blue/Mt Ararat/Morse XC/Messalonskee High as the teams print them.
